title: SkillsArchive
description: Owner archive for user skills of the shared CODEX_HOME (capability skills-archive). GET /v2/codex/skills/archive → archiveList; POST /v2/codex/skills/archive {requestId, path} → archiveResult (409 skill_not_archivable with details.reason system | plugin | not_user_skill, 409 skill_read_only, 404 skill_not_found); POST /v2/codex/skills/archive/{id}/restore {requestId} → archiveResult (409 skill_name_taken | skill_root_changed | skill_already_restored | skill_archive_incomplete, 404 skill_archive_not_found). Both POSTs are idempotent by requestId (replayed: true). Skills are moved, never copied or deleted.

path.description: A skill's path from skills/list: its SKILL.md or its directory (absolute).

id.description: <UTC yyyymmddThhmmssZ>-<dir name>; the archive slot <cutex home>/archive/skills/<id>.

originalPath.description: Where the entry was and where restore puts it back.

entryKind.description: link: a symlink / junction in the root was moved, its target untouched.

archivePath.description: Active archives only: the moved entry.

replayed.description: true: an earlier request with this requestId already did it; nothing moved now.
